title_sq: Apartament - Për Shitje - Rruga Mine Peza, Tiranë
description_sq:
Apartament 1+1 ne shije ne nje nga zonat me te kerkuara te Tiranes.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje nga zonat qendrore te Tiranes dhe me akses te shpejte ne akset kryesore.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje ndetim te ri dhe ka organizim optimal.
Organizohet si me poshte:
-sallon +kuzhine
-dhome gjumi
-tualet
-ballkon me dalje nga te dy dhomat.
title_en: Apartment - For Sale - Mine Peza Street, Tirana
description_en: Tasteful 1+1 apartment in one of the most sought after areas of Tirana. The apartment is located in one of the central areas of Tirana and with quick access to the main roads. The apartment is located in a new building and has optimal organization. It is organized as follows: - living room + kitchen - bedroom - toilets - balcony with exit from both rooms.
